stories.title: Ask it anything
stories.text: Questions about the app, your quota or life get a straight answer, and a line on what the canvas could keep for them. Asking about the system prompt is no longer stopped as an attack.

stories.title: Shift-Return for a new line
stories.text: Shift-Return breaks the line in the chat field; Return still sends.

stories.title: The trading key waits for a deposit
stories.text: Hyperliquid takes a trading key once the account has had a deposit. Until then the first steps don't ask for Touch ID; afterwards Settings › Wallet › Key and signing has the button.

stories.title: Updates by themselves
stories.text: ihatecrypto looks for a new version once a day. When one is ready you get a notification; Install shows what changed first.

stories.title: A sound for each thing
stories.text: A coin rings when money arrives or a move finishes, a soft chime when something wants a look, a low knock when a move fails.

stories.title: The real token wears a badge
stories.text: A token shows by its ticker, and the verified one has a blue rosette. «buy STONK» takes the real STONK, not a copy with a fake pool; what you bought here shows its profit next to the amount.

stories.title: Any site, with your wallet
stories.text: «open kamino.com» opens the site beside the chat with your wallet, and every signature shows first. Drag the panel anywhere. Sites on MetaMask's phishing list don't open.

stories.title: Rewards sell themselves
stories.text: «every hour: sweep rewards over $10 into USDC» claims what Merkl owes once it's worth $10 and sells it for USDC; under $5 nothing is signed. From the automation wallet it runs without Touch ID.
stories.try: every hour: sweep rewards over $10 into USDC

stories.title: / and @ in the chat
stories.text: Type / for the blocks you can add, with an example to finish. Type @ for names from your address book and favorite tokens.
